verses.sanskrit:
जनमेजय उवाच।
              मन्वन्तरस्य सङ्ख्यानं युगानां च महामते। ब्रह्मणोऽह्नः प्रमाणं च वक्तुमर्हसि मे द्विज॥१॥
verses.english: ४। तामस मन्वन्तरम्: Now let me say something about fourth time cycle called tAmasa manvantaram... in this period the seven-sages are: काव्य, पृथु, अग्नि, जन्यु, धाता, कपीवान्, and अ-कपीवान्... and they had many sons, so say पुराणा-s... the devA hosts in this time-cycle, तामस मन्वन्तरम्, are called सत्या-s...

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              अहोरात्रं भजेत् सूर्यो मानवं लौकिकं परम्। तामुपादाय गणनां शृणु सङ्ख्यामरिन्दम॥२॥
verses.english: The Sun has devised day and night for the convenient computation of time for the smooth conduct of human affairs in this world and the other, basing on which the division of time is devised... that you listen first...
verses.bhavadeepa: मन्वन्तरप्रसङ्ख्यानं युगमानं तथैव च। ब्रह्मणोऽह्नः प्रसङ्ख्यानमष्टमेऽध्याय ईर्यते॥१॥ मन्वन्तरस्येति अध्यायः सर्वस्य कालपरिच्छेददर्शनार्थः॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: निमेषैः पञ्चदशभिः काष्ठा त्रिंशत्तु ताः कलाः। त्रिंशत्कलो मुहूर्तस्तु त्रिंशता तैर्मनीषिणः॥३॥
verses.english: Next, त्रेत-युग is of three thousand year duration, and the opening period of that era, say सन्ध्य is of three hundred years, where the closing period, say सन्ध्य-अम्श, is also of the same duration, i.e., three hundred years...
verses.bhavadeepa: देवादीनाम् अहोरात्राणि भजेत् पृथक् कुर्यात्। विभजते इति पाठे सूर्य इति शेषः। लौकिकम् अस्मदीयं मानवं मनोः परं द्विपरार्धरूपं ब्राह्मं तां तत्सम्बन्धिनीं लोकप्रसिद्धां गणनामुपादाय उपजीव्य देवाद्यहोरात्राणां सङ्ख्यां शृणु॥२॥

verses.sanskrit: अहोरात्रमिति प्राहुश्चन्द्रसूर्यगतिं नृप। विशेषेण तु सर्वेषु अहोरात्रे च नित्यशः॥४॥
verses.english: Day and night are the occurrences, they say, owing to the circumambulation of sun and moon around Mt. Meru, centric to earth, whereat one sets down while the other rises up... thus the day and night regularly occur everywhere on earth surrounding Mt. Meru - मेरोः परीतो भू प्रदेशेSउ...
verses.bhavadeepa: अष्टादश निमेषास्तु काष्ठा इत्यस्य मूलं मृग्यम्। विष्णुपुराणेऽपि “काष्ठा निमेषा दश पञ्च चैव” इत्येतावत्या एव सङ्ख्याया दर्शनात्। तैर्मुहूर्तैस्त्रिंशताऽहोरात्रमिति प्राहुरित्युत्तरेणान्वयः॥३॥

verses.sanskrit: अहोरात्राः पञ्चदश पक्ष इत्यभिशब्दितः। द्वौ पक्षौ तु स्मृतो मासो मासौ द्वावृतुरुच्यते॥५॥
verses.english: Fifteen such days and nights become a fortnight... two fortnights form a month, and two months a R^itu...
verses.bhavadeepa: अहोरात्रलक्षणमाह- चन्द्रेति॥ विशेषेण परिदृश्यमाना चन्द्रसूर्ययोर्गतिरुदयादुदयान्तरावधिः तां तावन्तं कालं सर्वेषु मेरोः परितो भूप्रदेशेषु अहोरात्र इति प्राहुरित्यनुषज्यते। नित्यश इति सार्वदिक्त्वमेतयोरुक्तम्॥४॥

verses.sanskrit: अब्दं द्व्ययनमुक्तं च अयनं त्वृतुभिस्त्रिभिः। दक्षिणं चोत्तरं चैव सङ्ख्यातत्त्वविशारदैः॥६॥
verses.english: This is how the count of 12, 000 years will come to a yuga, say catur-yuga period, taking the count of 12, 000 divine years of devatA-s...

verses.sanskrit: मानेनानेन यो मासः पक्षद्वयसमन्वितः। पितॄणां तदहोरात्रमिति कालविदो विदुः॥७॥
verses.english: If a month composed of two fortnights is achieved thus, that month is said to be one day and one night for manes, पितृ देवता-s, so say experts in time calculations...

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णपक्षस्त्वहस्तेषां शुक्लपक्षस्तु शर्वरी। कृष्णपक्ष त्वहः श्राद्धं पितॄणां वर्तते नृप॥८॥
verses.english: Black-fortnight is day and white-fortnight is night for those manes... thus, if श्रद्ध, yearly obsequial rites to manes, is to be performed, they are performed during black-fortnight, say days heading towards अमावास्य, no-moon-day, because it is the day time of manes, पितृ देवता-s..

verses.sanskrit: मानुषेण तु मानेन यो वै संवत्सरः स्मृतः। देवानां तदहोरात्रं दिवा चैवोत्तरायणम्। दक्षिणायनं स्मृता रात्रिः प्राज्ञैस्तत्त्वार्थकोविदैः॥९॥
verses.english: That which is called one year according to human calculations, it one day and one night for devatA-s... in that, day-time is उत्तर-अयनम्, northern solstice and night-time दक्षिण-अयनम्, southern solstice... so say experts...
verses.bhavadeepa: कृष्णेति। चन्द्रलोकस्थाः पितरः शुक्लपक्षे चन्द्रान्तर्हितं सूर्यं न पश्यन्ति कृष्णे तु चन्द्रसूर्याभिमुख्यात्तदाश्रितास्तं पश्यन्तीति शुक्लकृष्णपक्षौ तेषां क्रमेण रात्र्यहनी अत एव कृष्णपक्षः सम्पूर्णो वा दिनान्तत्वादत्यावश्यकतया अमावास्या श्राद्धकाल इत्यर्थः॥८॥

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यमब्दं दशगुणमहोरात्रं मनोः स्मृतम्। अहोरात्रं दशगुणं मानवः पक्ष उच्यते॥१०॥
verses.english: Ten such years of devatA-s will become one day and night of each manu, say one day of manu, and ten such manu-days will become a manu-fortnight...
verses.bhavadeepa: मानुषेणेति सार्द्धम्। मकरादामिथुनान्तं रविरथाक्षरश्म्योर्ध्रुवेणाकर्षणेऽनुदिनं क्रियमाणे उत्तराभिमुखः सूर्यो मेरुमूर्द्धस्थानां देवानां दृश्यो भवतीति तेषां तदा दिनम् कर्काद्यावद्धनुरन्तं तयोरेव रश्म्योर्ध्रुवेण क्रमादुन्मोचने क्रियमाणे दक्षिणाभिमुखः सूर्यो देवानामदृश्यो भवतीति तदा तेषां रात्रिरिति॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: पक्षो दशगुणो मासो मासैर्द्वादशभिर्गुणैः। ऋतुर्मनूनां सम्प्रोक्तः प्राज्ञैस्तत्वार्थदर्शिभिः। ऋतुत्रयेण त्वयनं तद्द्वयेनैव वत्सरः॥११॥
verses.english: And ten such manu-fortnights will become one manu-month... and twelve such months are one season, manu-R^itu... thus three seasons, i.e., manu-R^itu-s, will become one मनु-अयनम्, and two manu-ayanam-s are one manu-year... so say the wise...
verses.bhavadeepa: दिव्यमिति। देवानां दशभिर्वर्षैर्मनोरहोरात्र एकः दशभिस्तैः पक्षः॥१०॥

verses.sanskrit: चत्वार्येव सहस्राणि वर्षाणां तु कृतं युगम्। तावच्छती भवेत्सन्ध्या सन्ध्यांशश्च तथा नृप॥१२॥
verses.english: And the wise men said that कलि-युग has a thousand year duration and each of its opening and closing periods have a hundred year duration...
verses.bhavadeepa: दशभिः पक्षैर्मासः तैर्द्वादशाभिर्ऋतुः तैस्त्रिभिरयनं तयोः द्वयेन तैः षड्भिः संवत्सरः द्विसप्ततिसहस्राणि दिव्याब्दा एकं मनोर्वर्षमित्यर्थः॥११॥

verses.sanskrit: त्रीणि वर्षसहस्राणि त्रेता स्यात् परिमाणतः। तस्याश्च त्रिशती सन्ध्या सन्ध्यांशश्च तथाविधः॥१३॥
verses.english: And ten such manu-fortnights will become one manu-month... and twelve such months are one season, manu-R^itu... thus three seasons, i.e., manu-R^itu-s, will become one मनु-अयनम्, and two manu-ayanam-s are one manu-year... so say the wise...
verses.bhavadeepa: सन्ध्यांशश्च तस्य पूर्वापरौ भागौ॥१२॥

verses.sanskrit: तथा वर्षसहस्रे द्वे द्वापरं परिकीर्तितम्। तस्यापि द्विशती सन्ध्या सन्ध्यांशश्च तथाविधः॥१४॥
verses.english: That much is said to be the night-time of brahma, during which brahma retires from creation, and spends time in yogic repose in nArAyana...

verses.sanskrit: कलिवर्षसहस्रं च सङ्ख्यातोऽत्र मनीषिभिः। तस्यापि शतिका सन्ध्या सन्ध्यांशश्चैव तद्विधः॥१५॥
verses.english: As to how coldness, or hotness, manifest with the manifestation of cold season, or hot season, so the manifestation of beings takes place when the night of brahma lapses into day...

verses.sanskrit: एषा द्वादशसाहस्री युगसङ्ख्या प्रकीर्तिता। दिव्येनानेन मानेन युगसङ्ख्यां निबोध मे॥१६॥
verses.english: When the four-yuga cycle is completed, the period of कल्प is deemed to have completed... then all beings will be burnt down by the radiation emitted from twelve-AdityA-s...

verses.sanskrit: कृतं त्रेता द्वापरं च कलिश्चैव चतुर्युगी। युगं तदेकसप्तत्या गणितं नृपसत्तम॥१७॥
verses.english: Each manu merges into brahma after completion of northern transit, while another manu will be reigning the world for this much of time...
verses.bhavadeepa: द्वादशसाहस्री वर्षाणां युगमित्युच्यते॥१६॥

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरमिति प्रोक्तं सङ्ख्यानार्थविशारदैः। अयनं चापि तत्प्रोक्तं द्वेऽयने दक्षिणोत्तरे॥१८॥
verses.english: This is how the count of 12, 000 years will come to a yuga, say catur-yuga period, taking the count of 12, 000 divine years of devatA-s...
verses.bhavadeepa: युगपदार्थमाह- कृतमिति। चतुर्युगी युगशब्दार्थः तत् युगम् एकसप्तत्या गणितं किञ्चिदधिकं च मन्वन्तरं प्रोक्तं सहस्रस्य चतुर्दशांशत्वात्॥१७॥

verses.sanskrit: मनुः प्रलीयते यत्र समाप्ते चायने प्रभोः। ततोऽपरो मनुः कालमेतावन्तं भवत्युत॥१९॥
verses.english: And if almost 71, 000 of these four cअतुर्-युग-s, namely कृत, त्रेत, द्वापर, and कलि are completed, then it becomes a manvantaram, time cycle of one manu... there will be southern or northern transits, अयन-स्, even to each of the manu-s...
verses.bhavadeepa: एतावता कालस्यान्ते मनोर्ब्रह्मलोकं प्रति गमनेनादर्शनं भवतीति तदेव अयनमित्युच्यते। तस्यापि मनोः द्वे अयने भवतः। पूर्वरूपमार्षम्। अयं भावः- इतः पूर्वं धूमादिमार्गेण गत्वा देवलोकं प्राप्याधिकारं निर्वर्त्य तदन्ते अधःपतनमन्तरेणैव उत्तरायणमार्गेण ब्रह्मलोकं गच्छतीति। तथा चोक्तं अधिकारिकान् प्रकृत्य– “कृत्वा कर्म दिवं यान्ति ब्रह्मलोकं सनातनम्।” इति॥१८॥

verses.sanskrit: समतीतेषु राजेन्द्र प्रोक्तः संवत्सरः स वै। तदेव चायुतं प्रोक्तं मुनिना तत्त्वदर्शिना॥२०॥
verses.english: Each manu merges into brahma after completion of northern transit, while another manu will be reigning the world for this much of time...
verses.bhavadeepa: प्रभोः लीनस्य मनोरयने गमनकाले समाप्ते सम्यक् प्राप्ते सति॥१९॥

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणस्तदहः प्रोक्तं कल्पश्चेति स कथ्यते। सहस्रयुगपर्यन्ता या निशा प्रोच्यते बुधैः॥२१॥
verses.english: And oh, king, when ten-thousand [eighty] time-cycles of manu-s are bygone, it is called one year of brahma... so say the wise...
verses.bhavadeepa: समतीतेष्विति सार्धः। अनेनैव क्रमेण अनेकेषु मनुषु अतीतेषु स वक्ष्यमाणो ब्रह्मणः संवत्सरः प्रोक्तः। कियद्भिर्मन्वन्तरैः संवत्सरः पूर्यत इत्याह- तदेवेति। अयुतं मन्वन्तराणि ब्रह्मणोऽहोरात्रमुक्तं तदनुपातेन अहरपि ब्रह्मणः कल्पश्च कथ्यत इति योजना। अयं भावः– षष्ट्यधिकशतत्रयं संवत्सरस्य अंशाः प्रत्यंशं चतुर्दश मनवः तेन चतुर्दशभिर्गुणितं षष्ट्यद्यधिकशतत्रयं चत्वारिंशदधिकसहस्रपञ्चकं मनूनाम् अह्नि भवति। तावानेव कालो रात्रिरिति अशीत्यधिकमयुतं मनवः ब्रह्मणोंऽशरूपे अहोरात्रे भवन्ति। अत्र चांशानां दिनानि किञ्चिदधिकानि पञ्च वर्द्धन्ते तानि विहाय अह्नां षष्ट्यधिकशतत्रयेण यावन्तोंऽशा मनूनामयुतेन पूर्यन्ते तावानेव ब्रह्मणोऽहोरात्रस्तदर्द्धं चाहुरिति॥२०॥

verses.sanskrit: निमज्जत्यप्सु यत्रोर्वी सशैलवनकानना। तस्मिन् युगसहस्रे तु पूर्णे भरतसत्तम॥२२॥
verses.english: Oh, best king of bharata-s, what is said as brahma's day, is also known s a कल्प... and what is said by wise as cअतुर्-युग-रात्रि, thousand-era night of brahma, in that night the earth together with its mountains and forests will be submerged in waters... and on completion of युग-सहस्रे = cअतुर्-युग-सहस्रे; thousand cअतुर्-युग-s, thousand four-eras, then the day of brahma commences, and the period till its completion is reckoned as a कल्प...

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मे दिवसपर्यन्ते कल्पो निःशेष उच्यते। युगानि सप्ततिस्तानि साग्राणि कथितानि ते॥२३॥
verses.english: And even if I were to talk for hundreds of years I can never complete the details of dissolutions and evolutions of each manu in manvantara, because an evolution ensues every dissolution, and a dissolution ensues every evolution... this much will suffice for our purpose...
verses.bhavadeepa: युगसहस्त्रे चतुर्युगसहस्रे॥२२॥

verses.sanskrit: कृतत्रेतानिबद्धानि मनोरन्तरमुच्यते। चतुर्दशैते मनवः कीर्तिताः कीर्तिवर्धनाः॥२४॥
verses.english: These accounts of Time, which influences everything, will come in all purANA-s, veda-s and all other texts, because recounting these accounts of prajApati-s will render good to everyone...

verses.sanskrit: वेदेषु सपुराणेषु सर्वेषु प्रभविष्णवः। प्रजानां पतयो राजन्धन्यमेषां प्रकीर्तनम्॥२५॥
verses.english: These calculations of time are found in most of the Purńas, with some additions occasionally, of no importance, as that of the year of the seven Rishis, 3030 mortal years, and the year of Dhruva, 9090 such years, in the Linga P. In all essential points the computations accord, and the scheme, extravagant as it may appear, seems to admit of easy explanation.We have, in the first place, a computation of the years of the gods in the four ages, or, Krita Yuga 4000 Yuga 4000 4000   Sandhy 400 Sandhy 400 400   Sandhynsa 400 Sandhynsa 400 400   4800 4800 4800 4800  Tret Yuga 3000 Yuga 3000 3000   Sandhy 300 Sandhy 300 300   Sandhynsa 300 Sandhynsa 300 300   3600 3600 3600 3600  Dwpara Yuga 2000 Yuga 2000 2000   Sandhy 200 Sandhy 200 200   Sandhynsa 200 Sandhynsa 200 200   2400 2400 2400 2400  Kali Yuga 1000 Yuga 1000 1000   Sandhya 100 Sandhya 100 100   Sandhynsa 100 Sandhynsa 100 100   1200 1200 1200 1200  12000. 12000. 12000. 12000. 12000. If these divine years are converted into years of mortals, by multiplying them by 360, a year of men being a day of the gods, we obtain the years of which the Yugas of mortals are respectively said to consist: 4800 x 360 = 1.728.000 = 1.728.000 3600 x 360 = 1.296.000 = 1.296.000 2400 x 360 = 864.000 = 864.000 1200 x 360 = 432.000 = 432.000 4.320.000 a Mahyuga. 4.320.000 a Mahyuga. So that these periods resolve themselves into very simple elements: the notion of four ages in a deteriorating series expressed by descending arithmetical progression, as 4, 3, 2, 5; the conversion of units into thousands; and the mythological fiction, that these were divine years, each composed of 360 years of men. It does not seem necessary to refer the invention to any astronomical computations, or to any attempt to represent actual chronology. 'One and seventy enumerations of the four ages, with a surplus.' A similar reading occurs in several other Purńas, but none of them state of what the surplus or addition consists; but it is, in fact, the number of years required to reconcile two computations of the Kalpa. The most simple, and probably the original calculation of a Kalpa, is its being 1000 great ages, or ages of the gods: ### Bhavishya P. Then 4.320.000 years, or a divine age, x 1000 = 4320.000.000 years, or a day or night of Brahm,. But a day of Brahm is also seventy-one times a great age multiplied by fourteen: 4.320.000 x 71 x 14= 4.294.080.000, or less than the preceding by 25.920.000; and it is to make up for this deficiency that a certain number of years must be added to the computation by Manwantaras. According to the Srya Siddhnta, as cited by Mr. Davis (A. R. 2. 231), this addition consists of a Sandhi to each Manwantara, equal to the Satya age, or 5.728.000 years; and one similar Sandhi at the commencement of the Kalpa: thus p. 25 4.320.000 x 71 = 306.720.000 + 1.728.000 = 308.448.000 x 14 = 4318.272.000 + 1.728.000 = 4320.000.000. The Pauranics, however, omit the Sandhi of the Kalpa, and add the whole compensation to the Manwantaras. The amount of this in whole numbers is 1.851.428 in each Manwantara, or 4.320.000 x 71= 306.720.000 + 1.851.428 = 308.571.428 x 14 = 4319.999.992; leaving a very small inferiority to the result of the calculation of a Kalpa by a thousand great ages. To provide for this deficiency, indeed, very minute subdivisions are admitted into the calculation; and the commentator on our text says, that the additional years, if of gods, are 5142 years, 10 months, 8 days, 4 watches, 2 Muhrttas, 8 Kals, 17 Ksht́hs, 2 Nimeshas, and 1/7th; if of mortals, 1.851.428 years, 6 months, 24 days, 12 Nris, 12 Kals, 25 Kshtshas, and 10 Nimeshas. It will be observed, that in the Kalpa we have the regular descending series 4, 3, 2, with cyphers multiplied ad libitum. In theory the Kalpas are infinite; as the Bhavishya: 'Excellent sages, thousands of millions of Kalpas have passed, and as many are to come.' In the Linga Purńa, and others of the Saiva division, above thirty Kalpas are named, and some account given of several, but they are evidently sectarial embellishments. The only Kalpas usually specified are those which follow in the text: the one which was the last, or the Pdma, and the present p. 26 or Vrha. The first is also commonly called the Brhma; but the Bhgavata distinguishes the Brhma, considering it to be the first of Brahm's life, whilst the Pdma was the last of the first Parrddha. The terms Man, or great Kalpa, applied to the Padma, is attached to it only in a general sense; or, according to the commentator, because it comprises, as a minor Kalpa, that in which Brahm was born from a lotus. Properly, a great Kalpa is not a day, but a life of Brahm; as in the Brahma Vaivartta: 'Chronologers compute a Kalpa by the life of Brahm. Minor Kalpas, as Samvartta and the rest, are numerous.' Minor Kalpas here denote every period of destruction, or those in which the Samvartta wind, or other destructive agents, operate. Several other computations of time are found in different Purńas, but it will be sufficient to notice one which occurs in the Hari Vanśa, as it is peculiar, and because it is not quite correctly given in M. Langlois' translation. It is the calculation of the Mnava time, or time of a Menu.  10 divine years = a day and night of a Menu. divine years = a day and night of a Menu. = a day and night of a Menu. 10 Mnava days = his fortnight. Mnava days = his fortnight. = his fortnight. 10 Mnava fortn. = his month. Mnava fortn. = his month. = his month. 12 Mnava months = his season. Mnava months = his season. = his season. 6 Mnava seasons = his year. Mnava seasons = his year. = his year.  Accordingly the commentator says 72000 divine years make up his year. This is according to Vishnu Purana. Here it is एक सप्तत्या, seventy-one divine years.

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरेषु संहाराः संहारान्तेषु सम्भवाः। न शक्यमन्तरं तेषां वक्तुं वर्षशतैरपि॥२६॥
verses.english: But, oh, king of bharata-s, we are told that there is a continuum of dissolution of beings followed by every evolution, during each manvantra...

verses.sanskrit: विसर्गस्य प्रजानां वै संहारस्य च भारत। मन्वन्तरेषु संहाराः श्रूयन्ते भरतर्षभ॥२७॥
verses.bhavadeepa: संहारसम्भवधाराया अन्तरं विच्छेदो ब्रह्म तत्तु वक्तुमशक्यं तज्ज्ञानं विना च न धाराविच्छेदोऽस्तीति भावः॥२६॥

verses.sanskrit: सशेषास्तत्र तिष्ठन्ति देवाः सप्तर्षिभिः सह। तपसा ब्रह्मचर्येण श्रुतेन च समाहिताः॥२८॥
verses.english: When the four-yuga cycle is completed, the period of कल्प is deemed to have completed... then all beings will be burnt down by the radiation emitted from twelve-AdityA-s...
verses.bhavadeepa: प्रजानां जरायुजादीनां सृष्टिसंहारौ मन्वन्तरेषु चतुर्दशस्वपि मध्ये मध्ये उपरतौ भवतः॥२७॥

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णे युगसहस्रे तु कल्पो निःशेष उच्यते। तत्र सर्वाणि भूतानि दग्धान्यादित्यतेजसा॥२९॥
verses.english: On the completion of this period of kalpa, this order of twelve Aditya-s along with creator-brahma will merge in nArAyaNa, who is lord, supreme in yoga, yoga itself, gnosis itself, perishless, loftiest god, and Almighty hari...
verses.bhavadeepa: शेषाः स्थूलभूतानि तत्सहिता देवास्तिष्ठन्ति तत्र हेतुस्तपसेति॥२८॥

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणमग्रतः कृत्वा सहादित्यगणैर्विभुम्। योगं योगीश्वरं देवमजं क्षेत्रज्ञमच्युतम्। प्रविशन्ति सुरश्रेष्ठं हरिं नारायणं प्रभुम्॥३०॥
verses.english: On the completion of this period of kalpa, this order of twelve Aditya-s along with creator-brahma will merge in nArAyaNa, who is lord, supreme in yoga, yoga itself, gnosis itself, perishless, loftiest god, and Almighty hari...
verses.bhavadeepa: निःशेषत्वमेवाह- तत्रेति॥२९॥

verses.sanskrit: यः स्रष्टा सर्वभूतानां कल्पान्तेषु पुनः पुनः। अव्यक्तः शाश्वतो देवस्तस्य सर्वमिदं जगत्॥३१॥
verses.bhavadeepa: आदित्या अपि दग्धेन्धनानलवत्स्वात्मानमुपसंहृत्य ब्रह्मणा सह विष्णुं प्रविशन्ति तेन स्थूलानां पृथिव्यप्तेजसां नाशो दर्शितः॥३०॥

verses.sanskrit: तत्र संवर्तते रात्रिः सकलैकार्णवे तदा। नारायणोदरे निद्रां ब्राह्मं वर्षसहस्रकम्॥३२॥
verses.english: That much is said to be the night-time of brahma, during which brahma retires from creation, and spends time in yogic repose in nArAyana...

verses.sanskrit: तावन्तमिति कालस्य रात्रिरित्यभिशब्दिता। निद्रायोगमनुप्राप्तो यस्यां शेते पितामहः॥३३॥
verses.english: When that four-era night of brahma has elapsed then that grandsire starts his day again with a mind to create anew and commences to create afresh... then, starting with abodes of ethereal gods - which gods are existent yet non-existent - दर्शनानाम् अदर्शनैः; सह विपर्ययो॥। मणि प्रवाल धारा मात्रम् - like the thread existing, yet non-existing in a given string of beads... together with those beings that are burnt by the radiation of AdityA-s; as well as the hosts of gods, sages, yakSa-s, gandharvA-s, pishAcA-s, reptiles, and rAkSasA-s... all are given a renascence commensurable with that of previous kalpa...
verses.bhavadeepa: अयं च लयः सुषुप्तिसदृश इत्याह- तत्रेत्यादिना॥३२॥

verses.sanskrit: सा च रात्रिरपक्रान्ता सहस्रयुगपर्यया। तदा प्रबुद्धो भगवान्ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः॥३४॥
verses.english: As to how coldness, or hotness, manifest with the manifestation of cold season, or hot season, so the manifestation of beings takes place when the night of brahma lapses into day...

verses.sanskrit: पुनः सिसृक्षया युक्तः सर्गाय विदधे मनः। सैव स्मृतिः पुराणेयं तद्वृत्तं तद्विचेष्टितम्॥३५॥
verses.english: The Makers of People - प्रजा-कार-s, प्रजापति-s - will emerge out of nArAyaNa, and start improvising beings... and some humans, gods and sages who lived in last kalpa with a detachment to wildly affairs leaving off the penchant for their bodily pleasures, they do not recur in the ensuing kalpa...

verses.sanskrit: देवस्थानानि तान्येव केवलं च विपर्ययः। ततो दग्धानि भूतानि सर्वाण्यादित्यरश्मिभिः॥३६॥
verses.english: Thus, he who knows the division of time, that Almighty नारायण has devised the sequential thousand-era day and thousand-four-era night; सहस्र-युग-दिन, सहस्र-cअतुर्-युग-रात्रि, because such an expertness is intrinsic in such nArAyaNa, thus he goes on making evolutions and dissolutions of beings perpetually...

verses.sanskrit: देवर्षियक्षगन्धर्वाः पिशाचोरगराक्षसाः। जायन्ते च पुनस्तात युगे भरतसत्तम॥३७॥
verses.english: Thus that great lord hari-nArAyaNa is manifest everywhere, because he himself is manifest, yet unmanifest - व्यक्त-अव्यक्त; स्थूल-सूक्ष्म-रूप... Because you asked me about वृSणि dynasty I had to dwell this much on नारायण, because he is the fount of both वृSणि dynasty and vaivasvata manu, whose manvantaram is running now... Again, it is because nArAyaNa wonts to take incarnations for the elimination of rAkSasA-s, for establishing complete welfare of the world, he emerged in this वृSणि dynasty, of which I am about to tell...
verses.bhavadeepa: देवानां सूर्यादीनां चक्षुरादीनां च ब्रह्माण्डे पिण्डे च तान्येव न किञ्चिदपूर्वं दृश्यते केवलं विपर्ययः दर्शनानामदर्शनैः सह विपर्ययो मणिप्रवालधारामात्रमित्यर्थः॥३६॥

verses.sanskrit: यथर्तावृतुलिङ्गानि नानारूपाणि पर्यये। दृश्यन्ते तानि तान्येव तथा ब्राह्मीषु रात्रिषु॥३८॥
verses.bhavadeepa: दग्धानि पूर्वम् आसन् तानि देवादयश्च प्राग् विष्णौ लीनाः सन्तः पुनर्जायन्ते॥३७॥

verses.sanskrit: निष्क्रमित्वा प्रजाकारः प्रजापतिरसंशयम्। ये च वै मानवा देवाः सर्वे चैव महर्षयः॥३९॥
verses.bhavadeepa: ऋतुलिङ्गानि शीतोष्णवृष्ट्यादीनि॥३८॥

verses.sanskrit: ते सङ्गताः शुद्धसङ्गाः शश्वद्धर्मविसर्गतः। न भवन्ति पुनस्तात युगे भरतसत्तम॥४०॥
verses.bhavadeepa: निष्क्रमित्वा नारायणात् निष्क्रम्य पृथग्भूय प्रजाकारः प्रजाकर्ता पुनःपुनर्भूतानि ससृज इति चतुर्थेन सम्बन्धः। किं सर्वाणि भूतान्यविशेषेण पुनः सृजति नेत्याह- ये चेति सार्धेन॥३९॥

verses.sanskrit: तत्सर्वं क्रमयोगेन कालसङ्ख्याविभागवित्। सहस्रयुगसङ्ख्यानं कृत्वा दिवसमीश्वरः॥४१॥
verses.bhavadeepa: ते सङ्गताः शुद्धेन ब्रह्मणा सह सङ्गः एकीभावेन गतिर्येषां ते तत्त्वविदः शुद्धसङ्गाः। शुद्धसत्वे हेतुः- शश्वदिति। शश्वद्धर्मः स्वाभाविको गुणो देहादिष्वात्मबुद्धिः तस्या विसर्गतस्त्यागात्ते पुनर्न भवन्ति नावर्तन्ते अन्ये तु न। विष्णुं प्राप्ता अपि मोहकञ्चुकापनयनाभावाज्जायन्त इत्यर्थः॥४०॥

verses.sanskrit: रात्रिं युगसहस्रान्तां कृत्वा च भगवान् विभुः। संहरत्यथ भूतानि सृजते च पुनः पुनः॥४२॥

verses.bhavadeepa: तत्पूर्वोक्तप्रकारं युगसङ्ख्यानम्॥४१॥

verses.sanskrit: व्यक्ताव्यक्तो महादेवो हरिर्नारायणः प्रभुः। तस्य ते कीर्तयिष्यामि मनोर्वैवस्वतस्य ह॥४३॥
विसर्गं भरतश्रेष्ठ साम्प्रतस्य महाद्युते। वृष्णिवंशप्रसङ्गेन कथ्यमानं पुरातनम्॥४४॥
verses.bhavadeepa: व्यक्ताव्यक्तः स्थूलसूक्ष्मरूपः तस्य मनोः तदंशस्य मनोः विसर्गं कीर्तयिष्यामीत्युत्तरेण सम्बन्धः॥४३॥

verses.sanskrit: यत्रोत्पन्नो महात्मा स हरिर्वृष्णिकुले प्रभुः। सर्वासुरविनाशाय सर्वलोकहिताय च॥४५॥
